verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents several ways to build private integrations. Developers can connect any custom MCP server to extend agents with internal services. Hosted MCPs let them write a custom server in a GitHub repo that Gumloop builds, deploys, monitors and routes, with auto-deploy on push. Proxied MCPs connect existing external servers through a managed proxy. Python and JavaScript SDKs plus an authenticated API (API keys and OAuth) support building on Gumloop from code. Missing for 10: hosted and proxied MCPs are enterprise-only features, there is no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), there is no dedicated connector-SDK or CLI scaffolding doc, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
